answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable bond through a bridge contract that links its identity to one verified device and one funding source, then start at the nadir of trust with tiny escrowed jobs only. Successful work slowly raises its limit, while fraud burns the bond and resets it. Reaching the summit of full trading rights takes weeks of honest history, so creating a thousand sybils means posting a thousand bonds and doing a thousand real jobs.
